issues.description: Customers report the app refuses their correct password, blocking account access.
issues.name: Password rejected during login

issues.description: Customers report being unable to access their accounts, and one also notes too many ads.
issues.name: Cannot log in to account

issues.description: A single abusive review objects to Spotify asking users for money, which the reviewer finds demeaning, though the review gives little detail about the specific billing issue.
issues.name: Spotify payment request perceived as begging

issues.description: Free users find core controls like choosing specific songs, skipping, and replaying previous tracks restricted after an update, which they see as a forced push toward paying for premium.
issues.name: Basic playback controls locked behind premium

issues.description: Customers report that the app lacks certain songs and genres, such as gospel music, which limits its usefulness.
issues.name: Limited song catalog and missing music

issues.description: Users report that lyrics fail to display for certain songs while appearing for others, making the feature inconsistent.
issues.name: Lyrics missing for some songs

issues.description: Customers report that recommended tracks are inserted into their own playlists or feel less relevant and fresher than before, frustrating listeners who want only their chosen music.
issues.name: Recommendations interfering with playlists and music discovery

issues.description: Customers report that song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume or complete after they manually reopen the app.
issues.name: Background downloads stall until app reopened

issues.description: Customers report that offline mode or downloaded content does not function as expected.
issues.name: Offline listening downloads not working

issues.description: Many reviews express general dissatisfaction or call the app bad without naming a specific feature or problem, sometimes tied to a recent update.
issues.name: Vague negative feedback about app quality

issues.description: Premium users report the app cannot connect to the internet over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some songs play at poor audio quality.
issues.name: Playback fails on Wi-Fi but works on mobile data

issues.description: Users report the app crashing or freezing after an update, preventing them from opening or using it.
issues.name: App crashes or freezes on launch

issues.description: Customers report that music does not play, whether through Google Assistant with Spotify playlists or because the app gets stuck on the loading logo screen.
issues.name: Playback fails and app stalls on loading

issues.description: Music playback halts partway through a song and does not resume where it left off, instead starting a different track.
issues.name: Playback stops unexpectedly mid-track

issues.description: Customers say the app shows too many ads, especially loud ones, making it frustrating or useless without a premium subscription.
issues.name: Excessive ads making app hard to use

issues.description: Customers report that the app's interface and features behave in unexpected ways, including ads replacing music, broken controls, and UX changes that are hard to disable.
issues.name: Confusing usability and intrusive ads

issues.description: Customers report that playlists play songs in unwanted random order and that they cannot easily play a single chosen song without going through the whole playlist and hitting a limited skip allowance.
issues.name: Playlist playback and queue control frustrations

issues.description: Users find the redesigned homescreen and music player layout harder to use, with basic playback controls such as seeking and repeat missing or hard to reach.
issues.name: Confusing homescreen and player layout after update
